events.what: Letzter, Pokrovskiy and Williams prove every sufficiently large n-vertex tree has gracesize at least (1-ε)n

judgement.doubts: The only criticism is an automated Pith Review summary the researcher never opened (F11); it is neither digestion nor a knock-down. The v2 of 31 July 2026 has no visible changelog and is not treated as a new event (F7).

corrections.why: F14: the status rests on an asymptotic gracesize bound ('the conjecture itself (gs(T)=n-1 for every tree) remains open'); a progress row settles nothing and carries direction null.
